text: 白杨树实在不是平凡的树
pinyin: bái yáng shù shí zài bù shì píng fán de shù
literal: white · poplar · tree · really · not · ordinary · 's · tree
natural: the white poplar is truly no ordinary tree

meaning.en: Mao Dun's refrain in praise of the poplar, a symbol of the steadfast, upright northern Chinese people: it looks plain but is far from ordinary.
meaning.zh: 茅盾赞美白杨的名句，以白杨象征坚韧挺拔的北方农民和抗战军民：看似普通，其实很不平凡。

examples.zh: 茅盾写道：“白杨树实在不是平凡的树。”这句话在文中反复出现。
examples.en: Mao Dun wrote 'the white poplar is truly no ordinary tree', a line that recurs through the essay.

examples.zh: 语文课上，我们齐声朗读“白杨树实在不是平凡的树”。
examples.en: In Chinese class we read aloud together, 'the white poplar is truly no ordinary tree'.

story.en: Mao Dun (1896-1981) wrote 'In Praise of the White Poplar' in 1941 in Yan'an, seeing in the tree the upright spirit of northern China's people at war; the sentence returns as a refrain.
story.zh: 茅盾（1896—1981）1941年写于延安的散文《白杨礼赞》，借白杨写北方军民的刚毅正直；这句话在文中作为主旋律反复出现。

usage.en: Quoted when praising something humble in appearance but remarkable in spirit. Familiar to every Chinese schoolchild from the textbook essay 《白杨礼赞》 (1941).
usage.zh: 用来称赞外表平凡而精神不凡的人或事物。因课文《白杨礼赞》（1941年）而家喻户晓。

pinyin: xuán xué zhēn shì gè wú lài guǐ
literal: metaphysics · truly · is · a · rascal · ghost
natural: metaphysics is truly a rascally ghost

meaning.en: Ding Wenjiang's sneer in the 1923 science-versus-metaphysics debate: metaphysics is a shameless ghost that survives by bluff and borrowed disguises.
meaning.zh: 丁文江在1923年“科玄论战”中的讥讽：玄学像无赖鬼，靠装腔作势、改换招牌混日子。

examples.zh: 丁文江斥为“玄学真是个无赖鬼”，把这场论战推向了高潮。
examples.en: Ding Wenjiang called metaphysics 'truly a rascally ghost', pushing the debate to its peak.

examples.zh: 讲到科玄论战，老师特意引了“玄学真是个无赖鬼”这句名言。
examples.en: On the science-metaphysics debate, the teacher quoted the famous line 'metaphysics is truly a rascally ghost'.

origin.source: 丁文江《玄学与科学——评张君劢的〈人生观〉》

story.en: Ding Wenjiang (1887-1936), a geologist, answered Zhang Junmai's lecture on the philosophy of life in 1923 with this essay; its famous opening says metaphysics is a rascally ghost that, run out of places in Europe, had come to China to cheat people.
story.zh: 地质学家丁文江（1887—1936）为回应张君劢的《人生观》演讲，于1923年写下此文，开篇即称玄学是个无赖鬼，在欧洲混不下去了，跑到中国来招摇撞骗。

usage.en: A sharp, polemical line; quote it as a historical remark, not as a neutral description of philosophy. 玄学 here means the vitalist, intuition-based thought of Zhang Junmai and others, not the Wei-Jin 玄学.
usage.zh: 语气尖刻的论战之语，宜作历史引文，不是对哲学的中性描述。这里的“玄学”指张君劢等人的直觉、人生观一派，并非魏晋玄学。

literal: rely · on oneself · not · rely · on · others
natural: rely on oneself, not on others

meaning.en: Zhang Taiyan's watchword of moral self-reliance: act on your own conviction and will, without leaning on gods, authorities or other people.
meaning.zh: 章太炎的道德信条：凭自己的信念和意志行事，不依赖鬼神、权威或他人。

equivalents: rely on yourself, not on others
stand on your own two feet

examples.zh: 章太炎一生奉行“依自不依他”，不肯依附权贵。
examples.en: Zhang Taiyan lived by 'rely on oneself, not on others' and refused to attach himself to the powerful.

examples.zh: 创业之初没人帮忙，他只能依自不依他。
examples.en: With no help at the start of his business, he could only rely on himself and not on others.

story.en: In his 1907 reply to Tie Zheng, published in the revolutionary journal 《民报》, Zhang Taiyan (1869-1936) argued that Chinese moral teaching in all its schools comes down to one root, 'rely on oneself, not on others' (依自不依他).
story.zh: 1907年，章太炎（1869—1936）在《民报》发表《答铁铮》，指出中国各家德教殊途同归，根源都在“依自不依他”。

usage.en: Quoted for self-reliance and independence of mind, in academic and general writing. In context Zhang meant a moral and religious stance, resting on one's own heart (自贵其心).
usage.zh: 用来说自立自强、精神独立，学术文章和一般文章中都常见。章太炎原意是道德与信仰上的立场，即“自贵其心”。

text: 调和者，社会进化之精义也
pinyin: tiáo hé zhě, shè huì jìn huà zhī jīng yì yě
natural: compromise is the very essence of social evolution

meaning.en: Attributed to Zhang Shizhao, who held in the mid-1910s that a nation should be built on accommodating differing views and interests, so that change comes gradually instead of through violent upheaval.
meaning.zh: 相传出自章士钊，他在1910年代中期主张立国应调和各方意见与利益，使社会渐进演变，而非靠激烈的暴力变革。

examples.zh: 章士钊倡导“调和者，社会进化之精义也”，反对以暴易暴。
examples.en: Zhang Shizhao advocated that 'compromise is the essence of social evolution', opposing the replacing of violence with violence.

examples.zh: 谈到民初的政治思想，书中引了“调和者，社会进化之精义也”。
examples.en: On early Republican political thought, the book quotes 'compromise is the essence of social evolution'.

usage.en: Attributed to Zhang Shizhao (1881-1973) and his 'building the state on compromise' (调和立国论) of 1914 in 《甲寅》. His related claim that 调和 is the great principle of founding a state is attested, but this exact wording could not be confirmed against the original, so no origin is given. Classical-style sentence ending in 也.
usage.zh: 相传出自章士钊（1881—1973）1914年在《甲寅》发表的“调和立国论”一脉。他把调和视为立国大经确有其说，但这一句的具体措辞未能对照原文核实，故不标出处。文言句式，句末用“也”。
